items.title: Reservoir hits Suno and Anthropic with copyright infringement lawsuits
items.summary: Reservoir Media is the latest music rightsholder taking aim at AI companies in the courts. It’s gone with a double-pronged attack, suing both Suno and Anthropic on the same day this week. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Claude’s lyrics are diluting real lyrics, say music publishers in latest Anthropic proceedings
items.summary: The big debate over whether or not AI training is fair use under US copyright law was taking place in court again yesterday, this time in the context of music, specifically lyrics, with the copyright legal battle between AI company Anthropic and the Universal, Concord and ABKCO music publishers

items.summary: Canberra, Australia – Today a group of 63 international media organizations led by the News/Media Alliance delivered a letter to senior Australian politicians asking them to reject proposed changes to the country’s copyright laws that would allow artificial intelligence companies to use copyrighted material in training…

items.summary: Musixmatch ha comprado Music Reports, la compañía de Los Ángeles propietaria del registro de derechos de autor Songdex. La operación, anunciada el 19 de octubre, incluye también la plataforma londinense de datos y licencias Blokur y el software de hojas de música Cuetrak, ambos de Music Reports. items.title: Former Eminem employee faces up to five years in jail after pleading guilty to stealing and selling unreleased music files
items.summary: In January 2025 unreleased Eminem tracks started to mysteriously appear online, prompting an FBI investigation that linked the leaks to one of the rapper’s former employees, Joseph Strange. He has now pleaded guilty to criminal copyright infringement and faces up to five years in jail

items.title: Anthropic Sued For Stealing Elvis Presley Music to Train AI: ‘Deeply Protective of These Iconic Songs’
items.summary: The owners of The King's IP are cracking down on the tech giant, adding one of music's most legendary figures to the massive legal battle over AI music.

tip.title: Trabajo por encargo: quién queda como autor se pacta por escrito
tip.body: Si produces para un cliente, define por contrato si cedes derechos, si conservas puntos de producción y si tu nombre aparece en los créditos. Sin contrato, la interpretación depende de la ley de cada país.

tip.title: Work for hire: put authorship in writing
tip.body: If you produce for a client, spell out in the contract whether you assign rights, keep producer points, and get credited. Without a contract, the outcome depends on each country's law.
